text.p: These are the leading stories in the Angolan press on Monday.
Reuters has not verified these stories and does not vouch for their accuracy.

- President Jose Eduardo Dos Santos told reporters this weekend that he was confident that a Government of National Unity and Reconciliation would be formed in Angola during the month of March. The President made the comments during a brief visit to Luanda by Namibian President Sam Nujoma.

- UNITA leader Jonas Savimbi's advisor in Luanda, Abel Chivukuvuku, told CORREIO that he is confident the government will agree to a UNITA proposal to discuss the programme of the government before the establishment of government of national unity.
